{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue (though not needed for conversion rate)
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()

# Print results for audit
print("Conversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conversion_rate)
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}")"}
